hook.description: The single opening promise. Under 48 characters and 10 words. It must be the caption's first line and the exact first on-screen line for a Reel or slide one headline for a carousel.

detail.description: The specific proof behind the claim: a source finding, named case, observed situation, or usable framework. Never invent a statistic.

slides.description: Required when format is carousel. 6-8 items.

onscreen.description: Max 48 chars. Burned onto the video.

direction.description: What is on camera during this beat.

reel_cover.description: Required for Reels only. The separate profile-grid cover; it must package the tension without repeating the first frame.

headline.description: 2-6 words, max 36 characters. A concrete situation with an unresolved tension. Must connect to the hook's subject and payoff; paraphrasing is welcome.

signal.description: Max 24 characters. A concrete number, trade-off, or proof fragment from the Reel, shown as a visual label.

layout.description: Choose the visual device that best fits the tension. Vary it deliberately across Reels.

caption.description: Full caption WITHOUT hashtags. Structure: hook, payoff, substance, POV line, send-oriented CTA.

hashtags.description: Exactly 5 or fewer. Instagram enforces a hard cap of 5.

cta.description: The send-oriented call to action, repeated separately for reference.

failure_mode.description: The honest reason this post might land badly or read as generic.

caption:
Faster drafting just built a bigger queue.

The real ai marketing bottleneck shifted over the last eighteen months from production capacity to strategic judgment.

When content generation becomes cheap and fast, volume stops being a useful metric. The martech stack has consolidated into broader platforms, turning personalization into a data engineering problem rather than a creative one.

Investing in speed solves a problem that was mostly addressed years ago. The higher leverage investment is training teams to evaluate outputs critically and killing mediocre work before publication.

The complete 18-month review and stack analysis is published on my site: https://www.rachitmishra.in/2025/01/20/future-of-marketing-ai-agility-social-media/

Send this to whoever is still defending their team's AI strategy using output volume metrics.
